note: The surface this site renders, pinned. check-freshness.mjs fails when a committed catalog stops matching its pin, when a catalog file has no pin, or when the product's live surface differs from what is committed. The pin is never rewritten automatically: the failure prints the new hash so the diff can be read first, and bumping a pin here is the operator saying yes on purpose. surface_sha256 covers tools, resources, and cli_commands with object keys sorted, and excludes generated_at and version strings so a plain re-sync of an unchanged surface does not fail.

toron-mcp.json.surface: AM-Rust parity projection of the toron MCP surface, emitted by `toron catalog` and copied by scripts/sync-catalogs.sh
